author: Karl Rock
description:
I asked a simple question: “Is the power out?”

The answer? “Yes, this is Pakistan.”

We both couldn’t help but laugh.

Power cuts are a familiar part of everyday life in many parts of Pakistan, where electricity shortages and load-shedding have been an ongoing issue.

Sometimes, the best response is just to laugh about it.
title: Asking a Pakistani About Power Cuts 😂
